extraction.Name: Elizabeth Prue (Jannis)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 20, 1918 by B. A. Olson
extraction.Buyer: Land was conveyed by deed signed by Elizabeth Prue Jannis and Foster W. Jannis to Wallace E. Root for $1.00 and other valuable consideration on May 25, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612719 issued; northeast quarter of section 23, township 41, range 25; there is no receipt of record; land mortgaged February 16, 1918 for $100.00 due in August 1918, and an additional mortgage dated March 25, 1918 for $500.00 due in 1919; document stamped Rosebud S.D. JUN 1929
